subject: geography
title: Migration
objective: Explain why people move and how to classify the movement.

lesson.opening: Migration is the movement of people from one place to another. It is driven by pushes away from a place and pulls toward another.

sections.heading: Push and pull
sections.body: Pushes include conflict, drought, unemployment, and persecution. Pulls include work, safety, family, and freedom.

sections.heading: Kinds of movement
sections.body: Migration can be internal or international, voluntary or forced. A refugee flees across a border for safety; an economic migrant moves mainly for work.

sections.heading: Consequences
sections.body: Migration changes both the place left and the place settled, in population, culture, and economy.

choices: Flees across a border for safety
Moves within a country for work

activities.prompt: Migration within one country is called…
Explain one push and one pull that could cause migration.
activities.context: Pushes drive people away; pulls draw them in. Real moves usually combine several.
